Dear WPP Media team,

I am excited to apply for the SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) Specialist role. With hands-on experience in on-page SEO, technical audits, and GEO, I have helped clients improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. At Episto, I manage SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and build WordPress sites. On mirook.com, I implemented structured data, entity optimisation, and an llms.txt file, measurably raising search health.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I am eager to contribute to Total Search projects and learn more about SEA. I thrive in collaborative environments and am committed to continuous learning as search evolves.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your team's goals.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) Specialist position at WPP Media. With a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, technical audits, and content optimisation. At Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I also track performance using SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to guide decisions.

On my personal project, mirook.com, I applied structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimisation, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. This experience has given me a strong understanding of how to connect search performance to broader business impact.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and currently taking classes to improve. I am curious about the evolving search landscape and eager to develop my knowledge of SEA. I value collaboration and am comfortable seeking input when needed. I am excited about the opportunity to work with renowned brands and contribute to Total Search projects.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
